annotations.title: Fetch a OneHome saved search by id

description: Fetch the agent-curated saved search by its id (UUID). Returns the search's name, filter criteria (`filters[]`), polygon, listing count, and the full list of OSK listing ids that compose the consumer share (`listing_ids`). Pass `include_listing_ids: false` to suppress the listing-id array if you only need the metadata. This is the canonical consumer-readable endpoint; the by-groupId variant is agent-only. `saved_search_id` defaults to the MCP's session context when omitted.
name: onehome_get_saved_search
title: Fetch a OneHome saved search by id
